name: Blackberry, Pear & Almond
desc: Dark berries, mellow pear and a restrained almond note.
method: Add all ingredients.
Run Drinks for 2 minutes.
Blend a little longer if blackberry seeds remain prominent.
science: Blackberries add fibre and polyphenols; almond butter adds unsaturated fat and some protein.
note: The almond is supporting cast, not marzipan.

name: Cherry, Almond & Oat
desc: Cherry-led, creamy from oats and almond rather than sugar.
method: Add all ingredients.
Run Drinks for 2 minutes.
Blend briefly again if the oats need further smoothing.
science: Oats add soluble fibre; dairy and almond butter increase protein and satiety.
note: If using almond extract, keep it tiny.

name: Blueberry, Almond & Oat
desc: Blueberry with almond and oats, creamy without becoming pudding.
method: Add all ingredients to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Drinks programme for about 2 minutes.
If needed, add a small splash of the stated liquid and Blend briefly to fine-tune the texture.
science: Blueberries provide anthocyanins; oats add soluble fibre; almond butter contributes unsaturated fat.
note: Keep almond butter to 15 g so fruit stays dominant.
